result: No matching personal paths, known device identifiers, personal contact emails, private key blocks or credential tokens found in the reviewed publication set.
notes: APK signing certificate contains generic PhoneDrive identity only; public certificate is required for APK verification.

Pattern scanning and manual review reduce disclosure risk but do not prove absence of every possible identifier.
